protocol.site: Ucayali River, Santa María reach, Peru
protocol.timing_scope: fresh process: source signing/revalidation, acquisition, same final playback, same analysis; common catalog search/pin freeze and build excluded; public-server cache uncontrolled
protocol.analysis: NDWI=(green-NIR)/(green+NIR), NDVI=(NIR-red)/(NIR+red); shared clear mask; positive NDWI is a water-index candidate, not validated river area; no composite or gap-fill

run_conventions.outside_aoi_values: source nodata fill: science -9999, Fmask255; preserve all source bits insideAOI including cloudy pixels
run_conventions.comparison_scope: Complete acquisition plus shared final Chronozarr encoder and same river analysis; Tile retains raw observation stores, Python streams straight to playback
run_conventions.exploratory_runs: python-1, tile-original-1, matched-* retained as diagnostics; excluded from final medians
run_conventions.common_support_threshold: exploratory >=80% clear AOI dates; intersection of their defined NDWI masks

browser.scope: local static hosting, WebGL rendering, temporal navigation and click-to-query; external requests blocked

original_failures: Per-asset PC signer HTTP429 on the 32-asset request before payload acquisition
Two-asset diagnostic rejected observed southern HLS EPSG32618 negative-northing convention
